description: Read the latest TestivAI visual regression results (visual-report/results.json). Returns a per-snapshot verdict combining the pixel diff with the DOM and computed-style signals. A pixel diff is likely render noise when the DOM and the computed styles both match and the diff is small and scattered; a diff whose DOM and computed styles match but that is concentrated in one area or over 1% of pixels gets its own verdict, not noise: it is a bad capture or a change the style check does not cover (size, overflow, transform, images…), so look at the diff (get_diff) before approving; when the environment the snapshot was captured in changed since the baseline (a browser build, OS or distro, device scale, capture method…) and the DOM and computed styles match, the verdict is rendering drift: the machine changed, not the page, never noise; a style-only change (identical DOM, different computed styles) is a real change, not noise, and so is any DOM change — both need human review. When the styles were not compared (style check unavailable), the verdict says so and does not call the diff noise: with an identical DOM it could be render noise or a stylesheet-only change, so look at the diff (get_diff) before approving. Missing baselines (committed baselines that got no capture this run: a test removed, renamed or skipped, or one that failed before it captured) get their own line: there is nothing to approve, and an intended removal deletes the baseline directory. Run the test suite first (e.g. `npx playwright test`) if results are stale or missing.
name: get_visual_results
title: Get visual test results
